shared_elements: carved/incised linear motifs on a stone surface
anthropomorphic form (schematic figure in B; small human faces within glyph blocks in A)
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic presence of schematic anthropomorphic elements and rounded/circular forms within a linear carved design, which any carving tradition could produce independently. A is a dense grid of stacked, self-contained square blocks packed with compact rounded motifs, while B is a single large ribbon-outlined standing figure with a spoked disc set beside a long horizontal comb-toothed band — utterly different compositional and stylistic conventions.
